s1.name: Discovery Call
s1.desc: A 30-minute no-obligation call. We analyse your business, current marketing activities and the goal you want to achieve.

s2.name: Audit & strategy
s2.desc: A free account audit and a full system strategy. You receive a concrete plan with numbers – before signing a contract.

s3.name: System implementation
s3.desc: Setup of all system components: campaigns, tracking, chatbot, automations. Full implementation in 14–21 days.

s4.name: Optimisation & scaling
s4.desc: Weekly data-driven optimisation. We scale what works and eliminate what doesn't.

q1.a: Collaboration starts at Tier 1 – pricing depends on scope and ad budget. Everything is discussed on the discovery call and we present a concrete offer after the audit. No hidden costs.

q2.q: How quickly will I see results?
q2.a: The first leads typically appear within 7–14 days of launching the campaigns. Full system optimisation takes 60–90 days – that is how long the algorithms need to learn and gather data.

q3.q: Am I locked into a long contract?
q3.a: We work on monthly contracts with one month's notice. We want you to stay because you see results – not because you have to.

q4.q: How are you different from other agencies?
q4.a: Most agencies set up ads and send a PDF once a month. We build a complete system: ad → landing page → AI chatbot → automatic follow-up → AI receptionist → CRM → dashboard. The system works 24/7.

q5.q: Which industries do you work with?
q5.a: We specialise in B2B (services, consulting, real estate, finance) and e-commerce. We have experience with companies generating €125k to €7.5M annual revenue.

q6.q: What if I don't have an ad account yet?
q6.a: We set up and configure everything from scratch. Meta Business account, Google Ads, pixel, CAPI – we handle all the infrastructure.
